blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines —Sen. Jinggoy Estrada has over P7 billion in “congressional initiatives” in the 2025 budget, former Public Works Secretary Manuel Bonoan said in written testimony submitted to the Sandiganbayan Fifth Division Tuesday. The anti-graft court is currently conducting a hearing on Estrada’s bail petition where Bonoan stands as a witness. READ: Jinggoy declines to enter plea in graft, plunder cases Estrada’s lawyer Lawrence Arroyo objected to the inclusion of this amount in his written testimony, citing relevance. However, special prosecutor Reza Derayunan said: “It is not irrelevant since it is part of the congressional initiatives allocated to Senator Estrada for fiscal […]...
